notes: Source: official Nureva HDL310 data sheet (nureva.com/hubfs/product-resource/audio-conferencing/nureva-hdl310-data-sheet.pdf), cross-referenced against product page nureva.com/products/hdl-series/hdl310. The HDL310 is a two-piece system: an integrated microphone/speaker bar (60" wide, wall-mounted, no user-facing ports of its own) plus a separate "connect module" that hosts all physical I/O — ports listed above are all on the connect module. Two of the RJ45 ports link the connect module to the mic/speaker bar over a proprietary Ethernet-cable connection (not a generic network switch port), so no eth- grade was assigned to those two; the third RJ45 ("Console Direct") is the actual network/internet uplink, so eth-1g grade was inferred (typical for this device class) since the datasheet does not state an explicit link speed — flagged as an inference. The power input is described only as "Input jack for power supply" with power rating "universal switching 100-240V AC, 50-60Hz" and an included country-specific AC power cable; this implies an external power brick with a DC barrel output into the connect module (modeled as dc-barrel), but the exact barrel connector was not explicitly pictured/confirmed in the sheet. No HDMI/video ports exist on the HDL310 itself — the datasheet's mention of "HDMI and USB cameras" for camera-zone switching refers to third-party cameras integrated elsewhere in the room system, not physical ports on this device. Not rack-mountable (wall-mounted desktop/room device), so rackUnits omitted. Category set to "audio" (audio conferencing/DSP device) and type to "Audio mixer" as the closest fit since "DSP" is also plausible but this is marketed as an audio conferencing system with integrated mic/speaker bar rather than a rack DSP.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB 2.0 Type B interface to computer or collaboration hub, on the connect module

ports.name: Aux Out
ports.note: 3.5 mm single-ended stereo jack, on the connect module

ports.name: Aux In
ports.note: 3.5 mm single-ended stereo jack, on the connect module

ports.name: Mic/Speaker Bar 1
ports.note: One of two RJ45 connections from the connect module to the integrated microphone and speaker bar; proprietary Ethernet-cable link, not a graded network port so no eth- grade assigned

ports.name: Mic/Speaker Bar 2
ports.note: Second of two RJ45 connections from the connect module to the integrated microphone and speaker bar

ports.name: Console Direct
ports.note: RJ45 for connecting the connect module to the network for Console Direct cloud management; datasheet does not explicitly state link speed, inferred as Gigabit Ethernet based on typical AV endpoint hardware

ports.name: Power
ports.note: Input jack for external power supply on the connect module; datasheet lists universal switching 100-240V AC, 50-60Hz, <30W consumption via an external adapter with a country-specific AC cord, consistent with a DC barrel input on the unit itself
